units.time: seconds of device uptime, the clock of ARFrame.timestamp and CMDeviceMotion.timestamp

conventions.world: ARKit world frame with worldAlignment .gravity: right-handed, y up (away from gravity), origin at the device's position when the session (epoch) started, -z the camera's initial facing projected onto the horizontal
conventions.camera: ARKit camera frame: +x right and +y up in the unrotated landscape sensor image, the camera looks along -z
conventions.device: Core Motion device frame: +x right and +y toward the top with the phone upright in portrait, +z out of the screen
conventions.pose: camera-to-world 4x4 matrix, 16 numbers column by column (simd_float4x4 layout), meters
conventions.intrinsics: [fx, fy, cx, cy] in pixels of the saved, unrotated landscape image
conventions.pixel: [u, v] continuous image coordinates: (0, 0) is the top-left corner of the top-left pixel, v grows down
conventions.ray: origin is the camera position; direction is a unit vector; camera-space direction ((u - cx)/fx, -(v - cy)/fy, -1)
conventions.geodetic: WGS84 degrees; altitude above mean sea level, ellipsoidalAltitude above the WGS84 ellipsoid, meters
conventions.heading: degrees clockwise from north, 0 to 360

source.sourceDataset: YouTube: 'House walk-around outside'; https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4h8kyjnPo9s; YouTube standard licence (all rights reserved by uploader)
synthesizedFields: keyframes[].pose (clean pose from the source + ARKit-like drift, profile nonlidar_2018)
keyframes[].intrinsics (source calibration + per-session focal and principal-point error)
keyframes[].features (SfM points re-expressed in the drifted world)
streams.imuRaw (from streams.motion plus gyro bias and sensor noise)
streams.arkitPoses (observed trajectory interpolated per epoch at 30 Hz)
